title: Docs IA: group Streaming + Tools + Structured Output under one nav section (plus minor SEO tweaks)
author: Elliot Price
description: Motivation: Streaming + tool calling + structured output are frequently used together and our current docs IA splits them across adjacent-but-separate sections. This PR groups them into a single left-nav section with consistent page ordering, improves cross-linking between pages, and makes minor SEO/heading adjustments (titles/H1s) so search results match the terminology we’re standardizing on (“tool calling”, “structured output”). This is intended to land alongside the content rewrites in #901–#903 so users see the new examples + troubleshooting under the same section. Scope: nav/IA only (no API behavior changes), but does include a couple of safe redirect aliases and heading normalization. Notes: We keep existing URLs stable where possible; for a couple of pages we add redirects to avoid breaking deep links; we also add explicit page descriptions for better snippet previews. Follow-ups: after merge, we should verify sitemap + Algolia indexing in the next docs deploy window and spot-check the “Tools” and “Structured Output” pages from quickstarts and SDK READMEs.
commits: docs(nav): group streaming/tools/structured under a single section
docs(seo): normalize H1/title tags and add page descriptions
docs(links): fix relative links and add redirect aliases
chore: update nav ordering and section labels
changed_areas: internal links from quickstarts/docs landing pages
notable_snippets: Nav grouping (excerpt): `[{ title: "Streaming, tools & structured output", id: "streaming-tools-structured", pages: ["/hosted-api/streaming", "/hosted-api/tools", "/hosted-api/structured-output", "/hosted-api/troubleshooting/streaming-and-tools"] }]`
review_conversation:
Wei Chen: The grouping makes sense. Two questions: (1) do we keep existing /streaming and /tools URLs stable, and (2) can we avoid “function calling” anywhere user-facing? Elliot: Yes—no URL changes for the main pages; we only add aliases for old links. Re: terminology, I updated the nav label and page titles to “tool calling” and added a redirect from the legacy function-calling path. Wei: Please also scan for any remaining H1s saying “Function Calling” in the structured output section; search results were confusing last month. Elliot: Done in commit 2; H1/title normalized and added meta descriptions.

Kira Thompson: Minor: the new section title is long in the sidebar on smaller screens. Can we drop the ampersand wording? Elliot: Adjusted to “Streaming & tools” in the sidebar label but kept the full section title on the landing page for clarity.

Henry Cho: SEO change looks fine. Please ensure “Structured output” stays distinct from “JSON mode” wording; Product wants consistency with PM-612. Elliot: Confirmed—titles use “Structured output” and we only mention “JSON mode” as a brief synonym in-body on the structured output page (handled in #903).

Ibrahim Khan: Redirects look good. Can you add a quick note in the docs changelog entry for the next release that nav changed but URLs didn’t? Elliot: Added a one-liner to the pending changelog fragment.

Approvals: Wei Chen approved; Kira Thompson approved; Henry Cho approved. Squash-merged after CI green.
release_notes: Docs-site IA update: Streaming, tool calling, and structured output are now grouped under a single navigation section; URLs remain stable and legacy deep links redirect to the new canonical pages.
